results.title: Dabafinance - Niger Receives 1.65M Liters of Algerian Fuel as Shortages Persist
results.snippet: Algeria and Niger signed 3 agreements in June to expand cooperation in the petroleum sector, including fuel supply, oil exploration and technical services. The agreements involve subsidiaries of Sonatrach and Niger's Sonidep. The companies have also cooperated on aviation fuel deliveries and other petroleum transactions. results.title: Nigeria's Aliko Dangote steps in to boost Cameroon's oil supply
results.snippet:
Audio By Vocalize

Africa's richest man, Nigerian tycoon Aliko Dangote, has agreed to step in and bolster Cameroon's supply of refined petroleum products, the West African nation's refinery company Sonara has announced.
